name: Lorenz Attractor
desc: A Lorenz/Rossler/Thomas strange attractor integrated in 3D and accumulated into a slowly self-rotating fading density buffer, its butterfly wings glowing in speed-and-depth color as plasma ribbon, thermal false-color, sumi ink, cyan blueprint schematic, or pearlescent oil-slick.

energy.doc: exposure / glow amplitude of the density field

density.doc: integration steps per frame (more = denser, brighter wings)
